doc: What a cell of a field shows: whether it has anything, which tile, turned how, scaled and tinted how.

fields.name: present
fields.doc: Whether the cell shows a tile at all.

fields.name: turn
fields.doc: Sixths of a turn about +Y (the hex looks the same turned).

fields.name: scale
fields.doc: Height scale for the tile's blades.

fields.name: tint
fields.doc: A colour the tile's colours are multiplied by.
